title: Prestressed silicon nitride square membrane: drum modes vs side length (3D, analytic)
description:
3D eigenfrequency study (solid_mechanics_3d on swept prism tetrahedra, quadratic elements) of a 100 nm thick high-stress silicon nitride membrane (E = 250 GPa, nu = 0.23, rho = 3200 kg/m^3, equibiaxial built-in stress sigma0 = 1 GPa as initial_stress_xx = initial_stress_yy) clamped on all four edges of an L x L square, L = 50 um (one value: the fine clamp-edge mesh grows with L, and 100 um no longer fits an 8 GB GPU). Quarter model: the two clamped edges on x_lo and y_lo (fixed), the symmetry planes through the centre on x_hi and y_hi (rollers: u_z free, so only modes even about both centre lines, (m, n) odd). Stress stiffening is on: the static state keeps u = 0 and the stress sigma0 (the clamps and rollers take the in-plane force), and its geometric stiffness carries the drum modes.
Analytic: an ideal membrane has f_mn = sqrt(sigma0 / rho) sqrt(m^2 + n^2) / (2 L) (f_11 = 7.91 MHz at L = 50 um). The film also has a little bending stiffness D = E h^3 / (12 (1 - nu^2)); next to a clamped edge it bends over the length l_b = sqrt(D / (sigma0 h)) = 0.47 um, which shortens the vibrating span by about 2 l_b and adds D k^4 to sigma0 h k^2: f_mn = f_mn(membrane) (1 + 2 lam + (4 + (m^2 + n^2) pi^2 / 2) lam^2), lam = l_b / L (Euler-Bernoulli string-with-bending expansion applied per direction; terms of order lam^2 from the corners and of order lam^3 are left out, below ~5e-4 here). The bending rise is 2.0 % at 50 um.
Mesh: in-plane triangles of at most L / 5 (cell size), refined to l_b / 2 in a band 4 l_b wide along the two clamped edges (refinement boxes clamp_band_x / clamp_band_y) so the bending boundary layer is resolved, graded at 1.3; two prism layers across the 100 nm thickness.
Solvers: double-precision cuDSS on both roles (the automatic cudss_mixed fails its accuracy probe on the static K of the tension-free 100 nm film and needs ~17 refinement solves per Arnoldi step on the pencil).
Derived values tab: f_11, f_13 (one of the degenerate (1,3) / (3,1) pair) and f_33 against the bending-corrected formula (expected within ~1e-3; tolerances 3e-3 / 3e-3 / 4e-3 are first estimates: the 3D clamp and the shear of the 0.47 um boundary layer differ slightly from plate theory); f_11_membrane against the ideal membrane, 2 % high (the bending stiffness).
Line profile tab (mid-plane cut): u_z of snapshot 'resonance 1' along the line y = 0.98 L / 2 from the clamped edge to the centre against the shortened-span shape sin(pi (x - l_b) / (L - 2 l_b)) sin(pi (y - l_b) / (L - 2 l_b)) (peak node |u| = 1 m at the centre); within ~1e-2 of the peak (the boundary layer itself is set to 0 within l_b).
